dimensions.assessment: Affects Medicare beneficiaries, healthcare providers, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services subject to the WISeR Model prior authorization rule.
dimensions.evidence: rule submitted by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services of the Department of Health and Human Services relating to 'Medicare Program; Implementation of Prior Authorization for Select Services for the Wasteful and Inappropriate Services Reduction (WISeR) Model'

dimensions.assessment: Completely nullifies a federal administrative rule concerning prior authorization for select Medicare services.
dimensions.evidence: such rule shall have no force or effect.

dimensions.assessment: Eliminates a model intended to reduce wasteful and inappropriate services in Medicare, impacting federal healthcare spending and administrative procedures.
dimensions.evidence: Wasteful and Inappropriate Services Reduction (WISeR) Model

dimensions.assessment: Exercises congressional authority under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, to overturn a specific federal agency rule.
dimensions.evidence: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services

dimensions.assessment: Permanently revokes the force and effect of the specified agency rule.
dimensions.evidence: such rule shall have no force or effect.

missing_information: The text does not state the precise dollar savings or budgetary impact expected from the WISeR Model rule.
The specific list of medical services covered under the disapproved prior authorization rule is not detailed in the resolution text.
importance_detail.rationale: This joint resolution provides for congressional disapproval under the Congressional Review Act of the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services rule relating to the WISeR Model prior authorization, rendering the rule of no force or effect.
